concerns.text: FR-001 (filtering by >500 lines via static analysis) lacks a complete implementation task. T013 (static analysis logic) is marked `[ ]` (incomplete) and T012a (streaming refactor) is also `[ ]`. Without these, the core filtering logic required by FR-001 and US-1 is unimplemented.

FR-002 (baseline execution) is blocked. T012c (writing filtered dataset to parquet/checksumming) is marked `[ ]` and explicitly rejected in the plan context. T016 (run_baseline.py) depends on this data artifact which cannot be produced by the current task list.

FR-003 (three context compression modules) has no implementing tasks. T020 (TF-IDF), T021 (Diff-Aware), and T022 (Semantic Summarization) are all marked `[ ]` (incomplete). The plan requires these to be implemented for US-2, but they are absent from the executable task list.

FR-006 (GLM analysis) and SC-003/SC-004 are untestable. T029 (GLM implementation) and T030 (comparison report) depend on data generation tasks (T012c, T023) which are currently broken/missing. The tasks describe analyzing data that the current task list cannot produce.

Constitution Principle III (Data Hygiene) and Plan structure are violated. T003 (requirements.txt) and T004 (pyproject.toml/ruff.toml) are marked `[ ]` (incomplete) in Phase 1, preventing the isolated virtualenv and linting setup required by the Constitution and Plan.

Plan contracts are missing. T006d (schema YAML files for TaskInstance, ContextConfiguration, ExecutionResult) is marked `[ ]` (incomplete). The Plan explicitly lists these in `contracts/` and T008a (validate_schema) requires them to function.

Stale/Conflicting Tags: T012a is tagged `[FR-001]` but marked `[ ]` (incomplete) while T013 (the actual logic) is also `[ ]`. The task list implies FR-001 is partially addressed but the implementation tasks are explicitly missing, creating a false traceability link.
